def.name: Nell
def.idle: I keep the hives and buy whatever you pull out of the lake. Three fish for a jar of honey — that's the going rate.

def.name: Old Rook
def.idle: Loon Lake gives up a fish to anyone who can stand still long enough. Most can't.

loonRanch.label: Loon Lake Shore
loonRanch.perkText: Horses earn 10% more XP by the water
loonRanch.blurb: A quiet shore east of the lake: eight stalls, a bigger string, and loons at dusk.
